'''1999 Decipher World Championship ECC Sealed''' was an unofficial Star Wars CCG sealed deck event with [[Enhanced Cloud City]] packs that World Championship players held late on Saturday 13 November 1999, after the awards ceremony, at [[DecipherCon 1999]] in Virginia Beach, Virginia. It is known from Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d110">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ day-one-world-championships], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 16 November 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026174240/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ Internet Archive].</ref> It was played alongside the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. It is a different event from Decipher's official [[DecipherCon 1999 Enhanced Sealed Deck]] (SW.20), the 176-player ECC sealed tournament earlier the same day, whose deck building began at 2 p.m. and whose play ended after 8 p.m.<ref name="cec-dc1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.1], Ryan Patterson, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030053/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Matt Lush Day One World Championships (tournament report)]] — by [[Matt Lush]], 3–1
* [[Martin Akesson World Championships by Martin Akesson (tournament report)]] — by [[Martin Akesson]], 1–2

== Same day, different events ==
* Decipher's schedule lists the official SW.20 Enhanced Sealed Deck (ECC+EPP) on Saturday 13 November, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.<ref name="dc99-sat" /> Its staff say deck building started at 2 p.m. and play ended after 8 p.m.; [[Mark Schaffer]] won.<ref name="cec-dc1" /> Lush calls his event unofficial and puts it late Saturday night, after the awards ceremony.<ref name="tr-d110" />
* [[Martin Akesson]] played both. He describes "one sealed deck tourney while watching the finals", then "after the dinner" "another sealed deck tournament", where he won one game, lost two and had a bye.<ref name="tr-d163" />
* The Squadron Members' own sealed event that night was a separate event: Squadron Members only, Players' Choice with OTSDs and packs, starting about midnight; see [[DecipherCon 1999 Squadron Members Sealed Deck]].
